svg.title: AgentShield full data flow
svg.desc: Step-by-step data flow from untrusted input through every security layer to safe action execution or containment.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the different types of untrusted inputs an AI agent can receive?')
sendPrompt('How does DID signature verification work for inter-agent messages?')
sendPrompt('What happens when DID verification fails?')
sendPrompt('How does the ingestion half strip arbitrary instruction tokens from raw content?')
sendPrompt('How is the composite risk score calculated from three parallel detectors?')
sendPrompt('What checks still apply to low-risk inputs?')
sendPrompt('What happens during the Dual-Intent Gate check?')
g.text: Model A + Model B, both must pass

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is logged when an input is immediately blocked?')
sendPrompt('How do agent role, data sensitivity and contamination window combine in the context risk engine?')
sendPrompt('How does the execution half receive only structured intent, never raw text?')
sendPrompt('How does the LSTM behavioral monitor check actions in real time?')
sendPrompt('What is written to the ILK on every successful action execution?')
g.text: Signed, logged to ILK hash chain

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the SHA-256 hash chain in the ILK detect tampering?')
sendPrompt('How does the continuous learning loop update detectors from attack logs?')
sendPrompt('How does the blast radius containment cascade work after detecting a compromised agent?')
